verdict.line: You lose if Mordekaiser lands Death's Grasp into Obliterate and autos before level 6; you win if you stay outside 700 range and let your Statikk Shiv/Liandry's spike around level 9-13 take over.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no ranged poke and exactly one way to reach you: E (Death's Grasp), a 700-range pull on an 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown. Teemo's Q and auto-attacks hit from 680, so every trade is decided by whether he lands that pull. Early on his pull is up often and his melee burst punishes any mistake, which is why he holds lane and solo-kill advantage levels 1-8 despite Teemo's 58.1% head-to-head win rate over 105 games. Once you item-spike and can out-kite his cooldown, the matchup flips hard in your favor.

theirWindow.when: E (Death's Grasp) is up, you're near 700 range
theirWindow.what: He can pull you into Obliterate and auto range, where his passive Darkness Rise aura ramps up after 3 landed attacks/spells. Back off to 700+ range whenever you see him near minimum E range and don't farm the wave edge closest to him.

yourWindow.when: He just used E (Death's Grasp) on you or a minion
yourWindow.what: He has zero gap-close for 16s at rank 1, down to 8s at rank 5. Walk up and free-hit with Q (Blinding Dart) and auto-poke with E (Toxic Shot) until the cooldown is close to running out again.

start.why: Taken in 69.1% of games (55.2% win rate over 87 games); the mana and AP keep your Q (Blinding Dart) and E (Toxic Shot) poke sustained through the early levels where you can't afford to melee trade.

boots.why: 75.6% win rate over 41 games. The magic penetration makes your poison DoTs and Q poke chip through Mordekaiser's shield from W (Indestructible) faster, shortening the window he has to stack it back up.

core.why: First item in the 53.6%-win, 35.9%-pick core path; the attack speed and movement speed let you kite the instant Death's Grasp is down.
Second item in that same path; stacks burn damage from range so you keep hurting him without ever entering his 700-range pull or his melee Obliterate.
Third item in the 53.6%-win core path; the cooldown reduction lets you re-apply Q (Blinding Dart) blinds more often to shut down his auto-reliant Darkness Rise passive.

situational.when: he's building Indestructible's shield fast and you need burst through it (seen in the 66.7%-win Shiv > Liandry's > Shadowflame line)
you need the attack speed to stack Toxic Shot (E) procs faster in extended kiting fights
the game goes long and you're ahead, to scale your Q/E/R damage even further out of his reach

runes.keystoneWhy: Landing poke autos and Q (Blinding Dart) builds the PTA debuff; it rewards exactly the hit-and-kite pattern this lane requires and adds burst the moment Mordekaiser is forced to stand still and trade.

summoners.why: Run in 85.6% of games at a 56.1% win rate. Flash is your answer when Death's Grasp lands and he's about to follow up with Obliterate; Ignite closes out early skirmishes since you rarely get to all-in him in melee range.

playing.title: Hold 680+ range at all times
playing.detail: Your Q and autos reach 680; his only gap-close, E (Death's Grasp), reaches 700. Standing right at the edge of your own range keeps you safe from his one engage tool while still poking.

playing.title: Track the Death's Grasp cooldown
playing.detail: It drops from 16s to 8s as he levels E. Count from the last time you saw it used and treat the window right before it comes back up as your most dangerous moment to be near him.

playing.title: Blind him before he gets 3 hits in
playing.detail: Darkness Rise (his passive) triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on you. If a trade goes long, Q (Blinding Dart) denies him autos and can stop the aura from ever turning on.

playing.title: Don't contest minions he can poke from range
playing.detail: Obliterate (Q) hits hardest on a single target and its cooldown shortens from 8s to 4s by rank 5. Let him have the occasional minion rather than trading auto-for-auto near his melee range.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to punish his pull whiffs
playing.detail: The instant he throws Death's Grasp and misses, or lands it on a minion, W's passive speed lets you close distance and free-hit before his next E is ready.

playing.title: Respect Realm of Death from level 6
playing.detail: It's a 140s cooldown at rank 1, dropping to 80s at rank 3, but it can drag you into a 1v1 he's built to win early. Play extra passive near his level-6 power spike until your own items come online.

playing.title: Flip the lane once Shiv/Liandry's complete
playing.detail: Around level 9-13 your kite speed and DoT damage start to outscale his all-in potential. Start walking him down outside his E range and punishing cooldown windows instead of just farming.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning (why the matchup plays out this way) is this coach's own analysis, not sourced data.
